name: agentmon-codex
description: Train a local-first Agentmon from approved Codex task prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Hatch and train from your Codex prompting style.
interface.longDescription: Creates a consent-scoped local feed from one Codex task so Agentmon can learn from user prompts without collecting assistant messages, tool output, files, or credentials.
defaultPrompt: Hatch my Agentmon from this task.
